Workout · Beginner

Recovery flow

Make the next hard session possible.

20–30 min · unloaded or light pack

Illustrative image

Session

  1. Move easily for 15–20 minutes on a comfortable surface.
  2. Spend a few minutes on comfortable ankle, hip and shoulder movement.
  3. Check feet, pack fit and how you feel before planning the next effort.

Progress

This session is not a test. Keep it manageable and use rest instead if you need it.

Working dose

15–20 min easy movement plus comfortable mobility. Adjust the example to your established capacity. Stop or scale if technique, balance or recovery deteriorates.
